details: Full run: the Windows pointer helper returned The system cannot find the file specified while moving the cursor; its executable exists.
First unchanged rerun: display-change stationary-cursor interactivity assertion timed out; diagnostics showed the cursor at screen edge (1775,32).
Final isolated rerun: blank-space click-through probe received zero clicks; diagnostic cursor was at (1067,635) rather than the probe near (90,54).

The cause is not conclusively isolated. Physical cursor activity was observed during these checks. Assertions were retained; no companion hit-testing, input behavior or mouse-helper changes were made in restart work.
The same case passed in the preceding visual-identity targeted run; that earlier pass does not replace the current failure. Repeat manually on an unlocked, idle desktop.
